sources.used_for: ProcessBuilder.start/Runtime.exec create native process and return Process controller object
volatile write synchronizes-with subsequent reads of same volatile variable; this is not a compound-operation atomicity guarantee
get returns null when map contains no mapping for key; missing key itself is not documented to throw NPE
computeIfAbsent computes and installs absent value atomically; not an equivalent to read-existing-only contract
Thread API covers handlers for abrupt uncaught-exception termination; Thread builder supports daemon configuration
VT map to fewer OS threads; blocking I/O can unmount/release carrier; synchronized/native/foreign blocking can pin; VT intended for waiting tasks, not CPU speedup
VirtualThread declares DEFAULT_SCHEDULER=createDefaultScheduler(); factory returns ForkJoinPool with CarrierThread workers, distinct from commonPool
§17.7 lines 668-674: non-volatile long/double may be split; volatile long/double and reference reads/writes are atomic
get has VarHandle.getVolatile effects; set has VarHandle.setVolatile effects; updateAndGet is atomic and may reapply side-effect-free function under contention
incrementAndGet atomically increments and returns updated value; equivalent to addAndGet(1)
Virtual threads section explicitly states virtual threads are daemon threads and do not prevent shutdown sequence from beginning
